description: Figure 16b, titled "MMLU confidence vs. accuracy," is a line plot that illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for the MMLU dataset using GPT-4.1 mini as the feedback model and Llama-4-Scout as the solver. The x-axis represents "Initial Confidence" on a linear scale ranging from 0.71 to 1.00, with tick marks at intervals of 0.02. The y-axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot displays three data series: "Final Accuracy" (blue line with square markers), "Δ Accuracy" (orange dashed line with triangle markers), and "Initial Accuracy" (green line with circle markers). The "Final Accuracy" line shows a general downward trend as initial confidence increases, starting at approximately 0.95 and ending at around 0.85. The "Initial Accuracy" line also trends downward, starting at about 0.65 and ending at roughly 0.55. The "Δ Accuracy" line, representing the change in accuracy, starts at a value of 0.0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.35 at an initial confidence of 0.81, and then declines to a value of about 0.15 at an initial confidence of 1.00.
